data: The most important things to know in your first week building Quiz Lab with Studio AI.
Where do quiz pack JSON files live in the Quiz Lab repo?

Each pack is a single JSON file in app/src/lib/data/packs/, registered in the packs index so the home page and the /play/{id} route pick it up (Pack Authoring Guide; Architecture Overview). static/quizzes/ was the deprecated v0 location.
How many answer choices must every question in a pack have?
The Pack Authoring Guide requires choices to be exactly 4 options per question. The old v0 format allowed any length, but it's superseded.
How is the correct answer to a question stored in the current pack schema?
The answer text in a 'correct' field
A boolean flag on each choice
correctIndex is a zero-based integer (0–3) that indexes into the 4-element choices array (Pack Authoring Guide). Storing the answer as a string was the deprecated v0 format.
What are the valid values for a question's 'difficulty' field?
difficulty is the integer 1, 2, or 3, rendered as ★ to ★★★ (Pack Authoring Guide; Product Vision & Glossary).
How many questions should a single pack contain?
The Pack Authoring Guide style rules call for 10–15 questions per pack, with mixed difficulty rather than all level 1.
In Quiz Lab, what is a 'pack'?
A themed set of quiz questions shipped as one JSON file
A pack is the unit of content: a themed set of quiz questions shipped as a single JSON file (Product Vision & Glossary).
What is Quiz Lab's entire deploy pipeline?
Push to a Vercel project with edge caching
Merge to main → GitHub Actions build → GitHub Pages
Manual 'npm run deploy' to an S3 bucket
A nightly cron that rebuilds the site

A GitHub Actions workflow runs on every push to main, builds the static site, and publishes it to GitHub Pages — merging to main is the whole deploy (Architecture Overview). There is no Vercel deployment.
What backend and database does the live Quiz Lab app use?
None — it's a fully prerendered static site

Quiz Lab is a fully prerendered SvelteKit static site with no server runtime and no database; all content ships in the build (Architecture Overview). Claims of Postgres or Vercel are out-of-date marketing.
How does a change get onto the main branch?
Through a reviewed pull request that is squash-merged
By pushing to a long-lived release branch
An agent force-pushes once tests pass
The team practices trunk-based development: you never commit directly to main; all work lands through a reviewed, squash-merged PR, and merging to main is what ships (Engineering Handbook).
What command must pass before a pack PR can be merged?
npm run build (in app/) must pass before a PR merges; a broken build blocks the GitHub Pages deploy (Architecture Overview; Pack Authoring Guide).
Which Studio AI MCP tool does an agent call to start working on a task?
work_on_next_task picks up a task — a specific number or the oldest backlog item — and moves it to inProgress (Studio AI SDLC & MCP).
In Studio AI, what is an 'idea'?
A hypothesis to validate, with a technical design
An idea is a hypothesis you want to validate, paired with a technical design; it is broken into PR-sized tasks linked as ideaSubtasks (Engineering Handbook; Studio AI SDLC & MCP).
When an agent picks up a task, what does Studio AI deliver alongside the task spec?
Nothing — the agent must search for everything
The full contents of every file in the repo
A list of all open pull requests

At pickup, Studio AI injects the task's curated context — a small neighborhood (~5 documents) attached to the task or its parent idea — so the agent doesn't have to go hunting for it (Studio AI SDLC & MCP; Engineering Handbook).
